euroc_mh01.baseline_source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED: norm of Stereo.T_c1_c2 in the attributed upstream ORB-SLAM3 EuRoC.yaml fixture; fixture profile only, not independent calibration
euroc_mh01.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED: upstream ORB-SLAM3 Examples/Stereo-Inertial/EuRoC.yaml copied into fixtures; EuRoC MH_01_easy image 752x480 at 20 Hz, IMU 200 Hz

d435i_n4b.source: SOURCE-SUPPORTED stream selection: experiments/2026-10-13-n4b-d435i-prep/n4b_plan.md selects Y8 640x480/30 and gyro 200 Hz. Requested/capability profile is not measured sustained delivery.

fx_fy_relative_tolerance.source: PROPOSED: maximum 5% relative difference between horizontal and vertical focal lengths for ordinary stereo pinhole settings

rotation_orthonormal_abs_tolerance.source: PROPOSED: absolute tolerance for R-transpose-R versus identity, allowing float32 OpenCV matrix serialization

rotation_determinant_abs_tolerance.source: PROPOSED: absolute tolerance for rotation determinant versus +1, allowing float32 OpenCV matrix serialization

homogeneous_row_abs_tolerance.source: PROPOSED: absolute tolerance for the homogeneous transform bottom row [0,0,0,1]

max_translation_m.source: PROPOSED: one metre upper bound for camera-camera and camera-IMU translation magnitudes; override for larger rigs

baseline_relative_tolerance.source: PROPOSED: maximum 5% relative difference between settings stereo baseline and calibration reference

imu_noise_relative_tolerance.source: PROPOSED: maximum 5% relative difference versus continuous-time noise values in the selected calibration IMU YAML after documented unit conversion

profile_rate_abs_tolerance_hz.source: PROPOSED: profile frame and gyro rates must agree within 0.01 Hz

extractor.source: PROPOSED: conservative bounds for ORBextractor settings accepted by the upstream implementation and useful for normal image pyramids

viewer_positive_max.source: PROPOSED: Viewer sizes, widths, point size, and image scale must be positive and below 10000 to reject nonsensical magnitudes
